dependencies.purpose: Required by passlib for secure password hashing; ensures production deployment has the backend available.

setup_instructions: cd backend && pip install -r requirements.txt && uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
documentation: Fixed production 401 on POST /api/auth/login by ensuring the demo operator is seeded lazily during login, using fallback credentials from environment variables or built-in defaults. Also added bcrypt explicitly to requirements to prevent missing dependency in deployment. No other changes were made.
